title: Irish monasteries preserve knowledge through the Dark Ages

tellings.quote: the Irish retreated into a series of monasteries and what they did was they dedicated themselves to preserving as much of the knowledge

plain: When the rest of Europe fell into the Dark Ages, the researcher Randall Carlson says, the Irish "retreated into a series of monasteries" and devoted themselves to saving as much of the old knowledge as they could. Carlson tells Michels this as a summary, drawing on the book How the Irish Saved Civilization. For him it shows how learning can survive a collapse by being hidden away and copied.
